trans-unit.source: No bugs, hurrah
trans-unit.target: Žiadne chybové logy. Hurá!

trans-unit.source: The bugs are hiding under the rug today. But we know where they live.
trans-unit.target: Bugy sa dnes schovali pod koberec. Ale my vieme, kde bývajú.

trans-unit.source: System clean as a freshly washed commit.
trans-unit.target: Systém čistý ako čerstvo umytý commit.

trans-unit.source: If something doesn’t work, it’s just an illusion – everything’s fine here.
trans-unit.target: Ak niečo nefunguje, je to len ilúzia – tu je všetko v poriadku.

trans-unit.source: Debugger is resting today. And so can you.
trans-unit.target: Debugger dnes oddychuje. A ty môžeš tiež.

trans-unit.source: Calm before the storm? Or a final victory?
trans-unit.target: Ticho pred búrkou? Alebo definitívne víťazstvo?

trans-unit.source: No bugs? Must be a trick… or a miracle.
trans-unit.target: Žiadne chyby? To bude určite trik… alebo zázrak.

trans-unit.source: Your code just hit the jackpot – bug-free zone!
trans-unit.target: Tvoj kód dnes vyhral jackpot – bug-free zóna!

trans-unit.source: The robot swept so well even the bugs gave up.
trans-unit.target: Robot zametal tak dobre, že sa aj bugy vzdali.

trans-unit.source: Don’t worry, if there’s no bug here, maybe it’s on vacation.
trans-unit.target: Neboj, ak tu nie je bug, možno je na dovolenke.

trans-unit.source: Code so clean you could eat it with a spoon.
trans-unit.target: Kód tak čistý, že by sa dal jesť lyžicou.

trans-unit.source: No bugs? You must have become a wizard.
trans-unit.target: Žiadne bugy? Asi si sa stal čarodejníkom.

trans-unit.source: Even the Matrix has glitches… but not here.
trans-unit.target: Aj Matrix má chyby… ale nie tu.

trans-unit.source: Everything runs smoothly, like a merge without conflicts.
trans-unit.target: Všetko ide hladko, ako merge bez konfliktu.

trans-unit.source: This is the moment when you can believe in miracles.
trans-unit.target: Toto je ten okamih, keď môžeš veriť v zázraky.

trans-unit.source: No bugs, just pure programming joy.
trans-unit.target: Žiadne bugy, iba čistá radosť z programovania.

trans-unit.source: Today you don’t need a coffee debug session.
trans-unit.target: Dnes nepotrebuješ coffee debug session.

trans-unit.source: Bugs? Please, those are already legacy.
trans-unit.target: Bugy? Prosím ťa, tie už sú dávno legacy.

trans-unit.source: Code so clean even linters approve it.
trans-unit.target: Kód taký čistý, že ho schválil aj linterna.

trans-unit.source: No bugs – no excuses.
trans-unit.target: Žiadne bugy – žiadne výhovorky.

trans-unit.source: QA can relax today, everything’s safe.
trans-unit.target: Dnes môže QA oddychovať, všetko je safe.

trans-unit.source: If there was a bug, you would’ve found it already.
trans-unit.target: Keby tu bol bug, už by si ho určite našiel.

trans-unit.source: Robot checked every pixel. Nothing.
trans-unit.target: Robot skontroloval každý pixel. Nič.

trans-unit.source: The code shines brighter than the sun on production.
trans-unit.target: Kód žiari viac ako slnko na productione.

trans-unit.source: Bugs are missing, but we don’t miss courage.
trans-unit.target: Chýbajú bugy, ale nechýba nám odvaha.

trans-unit.source: Nothing to fix here. Sorry, dev.
trans-unit.target: Tu nie je nič na fixnutie. Prepáč, dev.

trans-unit.source: Everything works so well it’s getting suspicious.
trans-unit.target: Všetko funguje tak dobre, že to začína byť podozrivé.

trans-unit.source: A bug-free day is a good day.
trans-unit.target: Bug-free deň je dobrý deň.

trans-unit.source: Nothing broke – are you sure you’re still in the right project?
trans-unit.target: Nič sa nerozbilo – ešte stále si v správnom projekte?

trans-unit.source: Even the TODO comments are hiding today.
trans-unit.target: Dokonca aj TODO komentáre sa dnes skrývajú.

trans-unit.source: Congrats, your code would pass grandma’s quality check.
trans-unit.target: Gratulujem, tvoj kód by prešiel aj babkinou kontrolou kvality.

trans-unit.source: Generate bug
trans-unit.target: Vygenerovať bug

trans-unit.source: Just funny 🙂
trans-unit.target: Len žartujeme 🙂
